campuses.text: Все факультеты + UPIC в пешей доступности. Современная Marine Station + Roland Levinsky Building (искусства).

paragraphs: University of Plymouth is a public university on England's south-west coast, with all faculties on a single city-centre campus in Plymouth. Founded in 1862 as a navigation school, Plymouth is best known for marine biology + oceanography (often top-1 in UK), nursing, business, and engineering. TEF Silver for teaching.

International students enter via University of Plymouth International College (UPIC) — Navitas's pathway college on the Plymouth campus. International Foundation Year, First-Year-Degree, and Pre-Master programs lead into a Plymouth Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: University of Plymouth — государственный университет на юго-западном побережье Англии, все факультеты на одном центральном кампусе в Плимуте. Основан в 1862 как navigation school. Известен marine biology + oceanography (часто №1 в UK), сестринским делом, бизнесом, инженерией. TEF Silver за преподавание.

Международные студенты заходят через University of Plymouth International College (UPIC) — pathway-колледж Navitas на кампусе Plymouth. International Foundation Year, First-Year-Degree и Pre-Master программы ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Plymouth.
